title: FedNIA: Noise-Induced Activation Analysis for Mitigating Data Poisoning in Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2502.16396v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Federated learning systems are increasingly threatened by data poisoning attacks, where malicious clients compromise global models by contributing tampered updates. Existing defenses often rely on impractical assumptions, such as access to a central test dataset, or fail to generalize across diverse attack types, particularly those involving multiple malicious clients working collaboratively. To address this, we propose Federated Noise-Induced Activation Analysis (FedNIA), a novel defense framework to identify and exclude adversarial clients without relying on any central test dataset. FedNIA injects random noise inputs to analyze the layerwise activation patterns in client models leveraging an autoencoder that detects abnormal behaviors indicative of data poisoning. FedNIA can defend against diverse attack types, including sample poisoning, label flipping, and backdoors, even in scenarios with multiple attacking nodes. Experimental

translated_title: FedNIA：用于缓解联邦学习中数据投毒攻击的噪声诱导激活分析
translated_abstract: 联邦学习系统正日益受到数据投毒攻击的威胁，恶意客户端通过提交被篡改的更新来破坏全局模型。现有的防御方法通常依赖于不切实际的假设，例如需要访问中央测试数据集，或者无法泛化应对多种攻击类型，尤其是涉及多个恶意客户端协同工作的攻击场景。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了联邦噪声诱导激活分析，这是一种新颖的防御框架，能够在不依赖任何中央测试数据集的情况下识别并排除对抗性客户端。FedNIA通过注入随机噪声输入来分析客户端模型中逐层的激活模式，并利用自编码器检测指示数据投毒的异常行为。FedNIA能够防御多种攻击类型，包括样本投毒、标签翻转和后门攻击，即使在存在多个攻击节点的场景下依然有效。实验（结果）……
tldr: FedNIA提出了一种无需中央测试数据集的联邦学习防御框架，通过注入随机噪声并利用自编码器分析客户端模型的逐层激活模式来识别并排除恶意客户端，可有效抵御样本投毒、标签翻转和后门等多种攻击，即使面对多个协同攻击节点依然有效。
